summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that Tom Allen and Mike McCoole had split the excursion money from their 1869 fight, McCoole taking $1,232.50 and Allen $1,000, while the stakes remained tied up in a lawsuit.

metadata.notes: No page image here, but the same headline appears on pg 3, col 3 of the April 21, 1870 Missouri Republican page seen for 030.

facts.fact: Allen and Mike McCoole had gone to law over the stakes of their 1869 fight, which were still undecided; they compromised on the excursion money, McCoole taking $1,232.50 and Allen $1,000
